answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen price despite the mandated 18% spend reduction, while the contract expiry prevents deferral. Prior experience indicates the lower-cost vendor materially reduced unit cost and onboarded quickly, making a primary switch the only direction plausibly able to meet the cost objective this cycle. However, the prior record does not establish delivery performance under a 94%-utilized, no-buffer condition, so its archived source should be verified before commitment and delivery-risk controls must be explicit in the award.
